about: Check-in chat replies for check-chat-context.mjs (made-up students). Regenerate with --refresh rather than edit.

why matched.ask: Why did you match me with my mentor?
why matched.reply: We matched you because you both enjoy live music and gigs, and you like similar weekends like going to the cinema. Your mentor is also the laid-back kind of person you asked for.

how often.reply: You'll meet with your mentor every two weeks.

checklist.reply: You have [[Book]] and [[Book]] left to do, plus finding a dentist.

who is my mentor.reply: You can find your mentor's name and how to get in touch on the [[Your Mentor]] page.

course society.ask: Can you suggest a society for my course?
course society.reply: Since you study English Literature, [[English]] fits your course.

why matched, waiting.ask: Why did you match me with my mentor?
why matched, waiting.reply: The mentoring coordinator is matching you by hand, so they will let you know the reasons once your match is ready.

why matched, no mentor.ask: Why did you match me with my mentor?
why matched, no mentor.reply: You haven't got a mentor yet, but I can find you one here. {{mentor}}

change mentor.ask: I don’t think my mentor is right for me. Can I change?
change mentor.reply: You can ask the mentoring coordinator for a different one on the [[Your Mentor]] page.
